questions.stem: Which type of electromagnetic wave is used in television remote controls?
questions.explanation: Television remote controls use infrared radiation to send signals to the TV. Infrared is also used in thermal imaging cameras, optical fibre communication, and heating.

questions.stem: Which type of electromagnetic wave is used to sterilise medical equipment?
questions.explanation: Gamma rays are used to sterilise medical equipment because they can kill bacteria and viruses. Their high energy and penetrating power make them effective for sterilisation, though they must be handled carefully because they are also dangerous to living tissue.
